quality_review.method: Direct inspection of completed native beauty and ACES 2.0 undenoised views at native image dimensions; selected actual data passes and matched comparison crops. No image retouching.

heritage.notes: Grounded camera and props; readable wear/labels; defined lens/metal reflections. Raw shading reviewed; fine residual Monte Carlo noise remains before OIDN.

beauty.notes: Porcelain pattern, food texture, linen weave and contact shadows inspected. Raw beauty retains fine sampling grain; native OIDN preserves the subject silhouettes and material detail.

interior.notes: Plant opacity and pot grounding corrected; vase and notebook rest on the tabletop. Leather, decorated porcelain, floor and plaster maps reviewed. Raw and actual object Cryptomatte coverage inspected; strong daylight highlights retained.

music.notes: Defined diffraction orders on a correctly proportioned CD in its tray. Electronics labels and contact shadows inspected. Fine raw diffraction grain is visible before OIDN; comparison uses an identical CD crop.

audio.notes: Completed 1280x800 CPU beauty, raw and official upstream pair inspected. Both engraved brass materials use roughness .98; actual material aliases targeted in both libraries. Identical geometry, maps, lighting, exposure and sampling retained. Stylised roughness isolates the compensation illustration.

jewelry.notes: Cloth was raised clear of the tabletop; no intersecting holes. Compass marks, notebook wear and spectacle contact checked in beauty and raw.

pearl.notes: Thin-shell archglass transmission and 470 nm interference, ceramic glaze, brass and contact shadows inspected in beauty and raw. Bubble interiors transmit straight through; this is a thin-shell approximation.

architecture.notes: Pool reflections, stone edge, leather, foliage, tabletop contact and wall finish inspected. Strong direct sun is an art-direction choice; this image is not an isolated caustic quality benchmark.

fan.notes: CPU beauty and undenoised output inspected at 1280x800. Wooden blades remain visible during a narrow shutter rotation; ceiling cap and wall structure checked. This image establishes the chosen CPU motion illustration only.

atmosphere.notes: Completed beauty and raw inspected. Bounded room medium, lower environment fill and reduced dust density preserve chair/plant/notebook detail and window shadows. Warm sunlight and visible haze are deliberate; fine raw grain remains.

prism.notes: Completed 1920x1200 Metal RGB dispersion beauty and raw inspected. N-SF6 wavelength-sampled dispersion, sharp facet edges, notebook and glass refraction reviewed. Residual fine raw chromatic noise remains; this is not validation of the rejected spectral-green candidate.

textile.notes: Completed 1920x1200 CPU beauty, raw and official upstream alternative inspected. Wool sits on the seat with surface-normal aligned curled strands. Leather folds and grain, wood reflections and contacts reviewed. Upstream Glossy2 is an explicit alternative, not a same-model Huang implementation.

perfume.notes: Completed 1920x1200 Metal beauty and raw inspected. Scanned bottle silhouettes, labels, caps, fruit, tabletop contact and controlled reflections checked. Deliberately opaque dark lacquer replaces the rejected transmissive bottle setup. Not liquid absorption or glass-volume validation.

quality_review.scope: A visual acceptance record for these authored images, not a universal photorealism guarantee, speed benchmark or blanket backend validation.

hardware: Apple M5 Pro (18 CPU cores, 48 GB RAM), native CPU and Apple Metal renders; per-image configuration recorded
scope: Art-directed CPU/Metal artwork and matched CPU material illustrations, not speed benchmarks or blanket GPU/Cycles validation.
display_note: Beauty and raw beauty: OCIO ACES 2.0. Technical normal, albedo and Cryptomatte images: actual scene data views.
